title: Nell and the Sap
note: b412 — Phase 2, 12-sound stage. Non-fiction note: tree sap really is collected in a pot and really is sticky.

pages.brief: A small wooden pot under a tree trunk, collecting drips of amber sap from a tap in the bark.
Nell the bee landing and sitting on the rim of a pot of amber sap.
Nell the bee dozing on the rim of a pot, close to the sticky sap.
Nell the bee slipping down into amber sap inside a pot, startled.
Pip the sparrow leaning over a pot, tapping gently at Nell to help pull her free of sticky sap.
Close view of a beak nipping carefully at sticky strands of sap holding a small bee.
Nell the bee free on the rim of the pot, smiling, a little sap on her legs, Pip the sparrow watching kindly.
